short.title: Ohio votes put three Amazon data-centre plans at risk
short.description: Three proposed Amazon data centres face uncertain futures following Ohio local votes. Read the full brief: https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
short.script: Ohio voters backed 21 local measures concerning data centres. Financial Times reporting identifies three planned Amazon projects facing delays or cancellation, representing more than seventeen billion dollars in proposed investment. They have not all been definitively blocked. Today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief has the details.
